Query catalog.

## Synopsis

```text
query
```

Words without brackets are required, `[ ]` marks optional parts, `a | b` alternatives, `...` a repeatable argument and `[,...]` a comma separated list.

## Description

Selects one of the predefined catalog queries and asks for its parameters.

## Examples

Pick a predefined catalog query by number and answer its questions:

```text
query
```
